stories.title: Bank of Canada raises benchmark rate to 2.5%
stories.summary: The Bank of Canada increased its policy rate by a quarter‑point to 2.5 percent, marking its first change after seven consecutive meetings and the first hike since July 2023. Governor Tiff Macklem said the move is needed to lower the risk that elevated energy prices will spread to broader inflation, while keeping the rate low enough not to restrain growth. Canada’s annual inflation was 3.1 percent in September, driven largely by surging energy costs.
stories.why: Inflation data can shift expectations for central-bank interest rates, bond yields, borrowing costs and household purchasing power.

stories.title: High‑speed Renfe train rear‑ends Iryo service after signalling error in Spain
stories.summary: Two high‑speed trains traveling south from Madrid to Seville were stopped after a computer failure in the automatic signalling system. The Renfe train, carrying 397 passengers, was mistakenly ordered to proceed and collided with the preceding Iryo train, which had 147 passengers, between Mora and Orgaz about 140 km south of Madrid. The crash caused broken arms, broken noses and a rail to pierce a passenger’s roof.
stories.why: It shows how signalling and operational failures can jeopardize passenger safety.

stories.title: Microsoft reports $10 billion revenue from OpenAI in Q3 2026
stories.summary: Microsoft said it earned $10 billion from commercial arrangements with OpenAI in the quarter ended September 30, 2026, about 11 % of its total quarterly revenue of $92.3 billion. For the full 2026 fiscal year, OpenAI‑related revenue was $24.1 billion, and the quarterly pace suggests an annualized $40 billion. Receivables from OpenAI stood at $7.2 billion at quarter‑end.
stories.why: The figure shows the scale of Microsoft’s financial exposure to OpenAI, which could affect both companies’ earnings and strategic decisions.

stories.title: India projected to cut debt‑to‑GDP ratio by 2031, says RBI deputy governor
stories.summary: RBI Deputy Governor said India is the only major emerging economy expected to lower its overall debt‑to‑GDP ratio by 2031. The statement was reported by The Economic Times. No further details on the projected ratio or the assumptions behind it were provided, but the comment highlights a contrast with other emerging markets that are expected to see stable or rising debt ratios over the same period.
stories.why: RBI action or currency-market developments can affect rupee volatility, hedging costs and foreign-exchange conditions for businesses and investors.

stories.title: Green financing in India rises to $82 billion, but flows mostly to established sectors: Report
stories.summary: The Landscape of Green Finance in India, now in its fourth edition, maps actual finance flows or disbursements across sources, instruments, sectors, and subsectors for financial years 2022-23 and 2023-24. According to the report, while green finance has increased substantially between 2016-17 and 2023-24, financial flows remain concentrated in established sectors and technologies.

stories.title: Voice AI in vogue: Nvidia releases new open transcription model
stories.summary: Nvidia on Wednesday released Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe , a free, open-weight model that transcribes audio in up to 40 languages. Nvidia’s latest voice entry comes during a busy period of AI voice releases: Mistral shipped Voxtral 3 earlier this month; ElevenLabs launched Realtime for instant speech in voice agents; and Salesforce released Launa-Omni, its voice model.

stories.title: India’s record bank cash surplus fades as RBI curbs rupee bets
stories.summary: Indian banks have seen their excess funds drop significantly as the Reserve Bank of India maintains liquidity tightness. The central bank has provided limited liquidity support and capped assistance at 1.5 trillion rupees.
